magazine.title: Mamdani loves Arsenal. He should challenge them to cut ties with the UAE over Sudan | Sasha Lezhnev and John Prendergast
magazine.summary: The New York mayor’s passion for the Gunners and human rights presents an opportunity to push back on the club’s lucrative UAE sponsorship Like him or not, there is no doubt that New York mayor Zohran Mamdani’s passion for certain issues is electric, and that passion played a large part in him getting elected. But today, two of his biggest passions are on a collision course. On one hand, Mamdani is now arguably the US’s most high-profile supporter of English Premier League champions Arsenal. A superfan since he was a child, he has put the Gunners into the American spotlight more than anyone since becoming mayor. The Empire State Building gleamed in Arsenal’s red and white when they won the Premier League title. He wrote an essay about what Arsenal’s championship means to him, talks about Arsenal at press conferences and interviews and inaugurated Thierry Henry Way near Times Square in honor of the Arsenal legend. Continue reading...

magazine.title: Is el clásico still the world’s biggest match? Three questions before Barcelona v Real Madrid
magazine.summary: The fixture’s relevance waned as the Messi-Ronaldo rivalry faded. Can Lamine Yamal and Mbappé lift it into a new era? For the best part of a decade, el clásico was more than just soccer’s biggest fixture. It was the defining narrative. At the peak of the Lionel Messi v Cristiano Ronaldo era, there were clásicos everywhere. Yes, when the two historic rivals clashed on the pitch, but also in the voting for the Ballon d’Or every year and in so much of the discourse around the sport. As the Messi-Ronaldo rivalry faded, though, so too did the clásico’s relevance. This isn’t to say matches between Barcelona and Real Madrid no longer matter. They always have and always will. In 2026, however, it’s difficult to measure a clásico’s standing. Is it still the sport’s biggest fixture? Continue reading...

magazine.title: Premier League: 10 things to look out for this weekend
magazine.summary: Max Dowman may get a chance, Spurs need to find balance at Stamford Bridge and Axel Disasi must make amends Premier League top scorers After seven games, Nottingham Forest’s record is eerily similar to last season: five points, five goals scored. A year ago Forest’s eighth game was a 3-0 home loss to Chelsea that marked the end for Ange Postecoglou, the second of four managers to occupy the dugout last term. There is no suggestion that Oliver Glasner is under similar scrutiny yet, but the Austrian needs to find solutions for the league’s lowest scorers. Morgan Gibbs-White is available after missing the narrow defeat by Arsenal, while Liam Delap may benefit from a return to familiar surroundings – 12 of his 14 career Premier League goals were scored for Ipswich, six of them at Portman Road. “What we need to improve is getting [Delap] into more positions where he can score,” Glasner said before Friday evening’s game. “He’s one of our best finishers.” Gary O’Neil also lacks a standout scorer, but he is squeezing goals out of his side. Eight different Ipswich players have scored in seven games; only Brighton and Brentford can better that total this season. Niall McVeigh Ipswich v Notti

general.title: İstanbul'da iki yakada ulaşım çilesi! Trafik yoğunluğu yüzde 80'e ulaştı
general.summary: Haftanın son iş günü akşam saatlerinde ana arterler ve bağlantı yolları üzerindeki trafik yoğunluğu yüzde 80'e kadar çıktı. İşte ilçe ilçe son durum... Haftanın son iş günü akşam saatlerinde trafik yoğunluğunun yüzde 80'e kadar çıktığı İstanbul'da ana arter ve bağlantı yollarında ulaşımda aksamalar yaşanıyor. Avrupa Yakası'nda, D-100 kara yolunda, Beylikdüzü, Avcılar, Küçükçekmece, Şirinevler, Bakırköy, Cevizlibağ, Halıcıoğlu, Okmeydanı, Çağlayan, Mecidiyeköy ile 15 Temmuz Şehitler Köprüsü arasında trafik yoğunluğu görülüyor. Okmeydanı'nda araç arızası ve Büyükdere Caddesi Maslak-Sanayi Mahallesi yönünde hasarlı trafik kazası bu bölgelerdeki trafik akışını aksatıyor. TEM Otoyolu'nda, Hasdal, Seyrantepe ile Fatih Sultan Mehmet Köprüsü'nde, Büyükdere Caddesi Sarıyer yönü ile Levent TEM bağlantı yolları arasında trafik akışı zaman zaman durma noktasına geldi. TEM Otoyolu'nun Mahmutbey-Esenyurt Gişeleri'nin Edirne istikameti ile Bahçeşehir-Esenyurt Bağlantı Yolu'nda araçlar güçlükle ilerliyor. Karaköy ile Beşiktaş Sahil Yolu'nda ve Dolmabahçe Sarayı önünde de trafik yoğunluğu giderek artıyor. Kennedy Caddesi'nde, Avrasya Tüneli'nin girişinde araçlar yavaş seyrediyor. Zonguldak'ta maden ocağında patlama! Ölü ve yaralılar var D-100 KARA YOLUNDA TRAFİK YOĞUNLUĞU Anadolu Yakası'nda ise Fatih Sultan Mehmet Köprüsü'nde Avrupa-Anadolu yönünde trafik yoğunluğu gözleniyor. D-100 kara yolunda Kadıköy, Ataşehir ve Sultanbeyli arasında araçlar güçlükle ilerliyor. Bazı toplu taşıma duraklarında da vatandaşlar yaşanan yoğunluk nedeniyle sıra bekliyor. İBB CepTrafik uygulaması verilerine göre, kent genelindeki trafik yoğunluğu yüzde 80'e kadar çıktı. Trafik yoğunluğu Anadolu Yakası'nda yüzde 83'e, Avrupa Yakası'nda ise yüzde 80'e kadar ulaştı.
